causal_checks.finding: Six-state external-lactate counterexample and two-belief obstruction are accurate. PASS/BLOCK repairs guaranteed initial identification within three commands. Root explicit-lineage review independently confirms the consequential distinction.

Reported single-readout/status worst cases match 3/3/4 commands for the 18-state graph and 2/2/3 for the 6-state graph. Two exported policies replay all 24 starting states and each uses at most three commands.

144/48 candidates are explicit prior-support extensions, not original all-active-seed reachability. Quotients have 139/33 classes and 8/24 equivalent pairs. Predictive-class homing is guaranteed from every initial observation fiber within four commands; this does not imply learning all initial catalyst identities.

Supplying one GA3P and one phosphate to each paired state, then requesting forward GAPDH, yields BLOCK/PASS. This expands interventions and changes the conservation class. The report correctly preserves equivalence within the original restricted interface.
Causal failure causes, corrections and detection links are consistent. Its short action recommendations inherit the explicit model and observation-channel qualifications in the report.
